name: Nimbl
verdict: Nimbl, the Italian maker of handcrafted cycling shoes that became the team's apparel partner in 2026, joined Pon.Bike's portfolio in 2023; Pon is family-owned. Nothing found.
note: Premium Italian cycling-shoe brand from Porto Sant'Elpidio; took over race apparel for Team Visma | Lease a Bike (kit maker from 2026, first supplying shoes). Its nimbl.cc mark is on the jersey shoulder and lower back. Rating note: brand of family-owned Pon (claims nimbl-pon-bike-brand, pon-family-owned); no relevant record found.
